skill.name: daily-routine-note
skill.description: Create today's routine note with the standard template when missing.

skill:
create routine,prepare routine,routine note,daily routine
### Create today's routine note 1. Call `read_file` on today's path. 2. If the note is missing, call `write_file` with `create_new` following the same template as yesterday's note. 3. If the note already exists, stop. Do not carry forward tasks or modify existing content.
